## What it is

A provisional parametric reconstruction of the Palm V aluminium back cover in the measured bilateral frame. The broad transverse crown, centered ramp emboss, downturned perimeter, inward return, and centered end notch are one formed sheet. The small offset Reset hole is cut after the symmetric shell is complete.

## Measurement policy

The sparse half-outline and section values come from the clean exterior point cloud and are mirrored before interpolation. The measured notch arch is about 32 mm wide, the smooth transverse crown rises about 0.30 mm, and the real centered ramp begins near Y=14.5 mm, peaks near Z=0.60 mm, and decays into the base shell by Y=40 mm. The reference supports the overall envelope and broad formed surfaces more strongly than the exact cut-edge and return geometry, so the 0.40 mm sheet gauge, 1.10 mm nominal skirt datum, 1.35 mm return width, and 1.80 mm Reset diameter remain provisional pending direct caliper measurements.

The source back group remains the comparison authority. Side groups, glue, fixtures, clamp observations, dents, scan texture, and cosmetic interior marks are excluded. The two lower symmetric circular observations are not modeled because this scan does not prove that they are formed aluminium rather than attached or interior detail.
